title: Unary representation of the halting predicate
statement: Let $c$ be a machine representation and let $s$ be a finite bit string. Form the unary word of length equal to the integer whose binary expansion is $1$ followed by $s$. This word belongs to the unary language that records, at each such length, whether $c$ decodes some representation $b5$ for which the decoded machine halts on an input $x$ when given the paired string consisting of each bit of $x$ doubled, followed by $01$ and then $b5$, if and only if there exist bit strings $b5$ and $x$ such that $s$ is that paired string and the machine decoded from $c$'s input $b5$ halts on $x$.
